attempts.summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4.1 share from node1 to node2. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500, the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770, and cross-node writes retain ownership and permissions. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs. RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160 remained unchanged.
